purpose: CSP without default-src: a policy that omits the fallback must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: Only script-src, object-src and frame-ancestors are bounded, so every other fetch directive falls back to the unrestricted default.

limitations: Observation mode: the fixture is a synthetic HTTP observation object, not a live request or a real target.
The case proves the declared DAST check evaluates as stated on this observation; it does not prove exploitability.
